title: Director Talent Acquisition
description:
The Talent Acquisition Director for Brazil is responsible for defining and executing a comprehensive national recruitment strategy aligned with business growth, client demand, and local labor market dynamics. This role ensures the attraction, selection, and retention of high-quality talent across multiple sites and business lines within Brazil, while driving innovation, operational excellence, and diversity in hiring practices.

Role Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership & Planning

  • Define and execute the Brazil Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with company objectives, national headcount plans, and client demand forecasts.
  • Partner with Brazil Operations, HR, Finance, and Workforce Management leaders to anticipate talent needs and capacity requirements.
  • Translate national business goals into actionable recruitment plans and measurable KPIs.
  • Develop workforce planning insights to proactively address hiring volume fluctuations, seasonal peaks, and new business ramp-ups within Brazil.
  • Leverage Brazilian labor market intelligence to inform location strategy, compensation competitiveness, and sourcing channels.

2. National Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop Talent Acquisition Managers and recruitment teams across multiple Brazilian sites to ensure consistent execution, capability building, and engagement.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure alignment with global TA frameworks, tools, and employer branding standards while adapting them to Brazil’s cultural and market realities.
  • Drive recruiter capability development in high-volume BPO hiring and specialized talent segments.

3. Operational Excellence

  • Oversee end-to-end recruitment operations across all Brazil delivery centers and remote hiring markets, ensuring timely, quality, and cost-effective hiring.
  • Monitor and report Brazil-specific TA metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, candidate quality, early attrition (training/nesting), and hiring manager satisfaction.
  • Partner with Training & Quality teams to ensure hiring quality translates into strong operational performance and first-90-day retention.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and implement automation, analytics, and digital recruitment tools to optimize hiring outcomes nationwide.

4. Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Act as the primary Talent Acquisition point of contact for Brazil business leaders, client representatives, and external partners.
  • Collaborate with Client Services and Operations to support new business transitions, site expansions, and staffing proposals within Brazil.
  • Participate in client presentations, RFP responses, and site visits, representing Brazil TA capabilities, performance, and innovation.
  • Build and sustain strong partnerships with Brazilian universities, job boards, government labor programs, and community organizations to ensure robust national talent pipelines.

5. Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Utilize recruitment analytics and Brazilian labor market intelligence to drive strategic decisions and recommend data-backed solutions.
  • Develop and maintain national dashboards to ensure visibility of hiring performance and enable agile workforce decisions.
  • Present regular updates to Brazil executive leadership on hiring trends, risks, productivity, and achievements.

6. Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

  • Lead employer branding initiatives within Brazil to position the company as an employer of choice in the Brazilian BPO sector.
  • Ensure a consistent, inclusive, and culturally relevant candidate experience aligned with company values and employer brand.
  • Promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through targeted outreach and recruitment strategies aligned with Brazil’s diversity landscape.

7. Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all recruitment activities comply with Brazilian labor legislation, data protection laws (including LGPD), and ethical hiring standards.
  • Maintain audit readiness and process documentation aligned with internal controls and external compliance requirements (e.g., COPC, ISO, or client-specific standards).

8. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital recruitment marketing to modernize hiring practices across Brazil.
  • Benchmark national practices against Brazilian BPO and talent acquisition market leaders to introduce best-in-class models.
  • Integrate predictive analytics and skill-based hiring approaches to anticipate Brazil’s future workforce needs.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Fluent in English and advanced Spanish proficiency (Spanish is not a must).
  • Proven experience leading high-volume, multi-site recruitment operations in Brazil (BPO or multinational environment).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field (MBA or postgraduate preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian labor market, labor legislation, and LGPD.
  • Demonstrated expertise in workforce planning, large-scale ramp-ups, and recruitment analytics (KPIs, dashboards, cost control).
  • Experience implementing and optimizing ATS, CRM, and digital/AI-driven sourcing tools. (Workday)
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills.

• Elaborar, revisar e acompanhar os planos de lavra de médio prazo (mensais, trimestrais e anuais), garantindo aderência às premissas operacionais, geológicas e estratégicas da unidade;

• Apoiar na construção e atualização do Master Plan da unidade, assegurando alinhamento entre os planos de curto, médio e longo prazo;

Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia de Minas;

• Vivência prática em rotinas diárias de mina a céu aberto;

• Disponibilidade para atuar em regime FIFO (18x10).

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL

BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.

Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.

Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.

Why joining us?

Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.

Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.

Why do we want you?

We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.

Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:

1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.

Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.

Competences:

a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.

Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.

Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.

· What do we offer?

1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.

Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Credit Control Senior Analyst
description:
About the Company:

HOYER is a global leader in providing comprehensive logistics solutions for handling and transporting liquid products for food, gas, mineral oil, and chemical industries. We safely deliver goods to their destinations – in tank containers, road tankers, and IBCs – by road, rail, and sea.

Visit for more details.

Desired Profile:

Provide senior expertise in credit risk and accounts receivable across the Latin America region, optimizing DSO, monitoring risks, and bridging junior team gaps (post-Beatriz transition). The role drives financial stability and cash flow performance via proactive analysis, process contributions, and scalable leadership potential across LATAM countries.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or related field.
  • Minimum 4–7 years of experience in credit control, accounts receivable, or financial operations.
  • Previous experience coordinating activities or mentoring juniors in multinational or regional finance environments is highly valued.
  • Advanced English required / Spanish preferred.
  • Advanced Excel and Financial Reporting Skills.
  • Experience with ERP systems and financial data analysis.
  • Understanding of credit risk evaluation and receivables management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Team coordination and mentoring potential.
  • Negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
  • Structured and detail-oriented mindset.
  • High level of integrity and accountability.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute credit control activities across the Latin America region.
  • Monitor accounts receivable performance including aging structure, overdue balances, and DSO evolution.
  • Ensure consistent application of group credit policies and internal financial procedures across all countries in Latin America region.
  • Assess customer credit worthiness and support approval recommendations for credit limits.
  • Monitor exposure levels within the debtor portfolio and identify high-risk accounts.
  • Support proper escalation and mitigation actions for customers with deteriorating payment behavior.
  • Monitor collection performance indicators and ensure timely follow-up of overdue invoices.
  • Assist in resolution of complex collection cases, disputes, or escalated customer issues.
  • Ensure that collection activities contribute to maintaining healthy regional cash flow.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Finance teams to resolve disputes and payment delays.
  • Provide input to commercial teams regarding credit exposure and payment behavior of customers.
  • Support alignment between commercial growth and financial risk management.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, group policies, and local financial regulations.
  • Contributes to the development and standardization of credit control processes across LATAM (addressing documentation gaps).
  • Identify opportunities to improve systems, reporting, and collection strategies.
  • Monitor periodic reports on accounts receivable performance, risk exposure, and collection trends.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to the Regional Finance Manager regarding credit risk and debtor portfolio performance.

What We Offer:

  • Global Career & Culture: Work in a consolidated global multinational with an excellent, collaborative work climate focused on well-being.
  • Flexible Hybrid Model: 40-hour work week (Mon-Fri, 08:30-17:30) with home office 2x a week (after probation) and a monthly remote stipend.
  • Premium Health & Wellness: Top-tier Medical and Dental insurance with immediate coverage and no co-pay (fully company-funded). Includes Gympass partnership and a "Birthday Off."
  • Financial Security: Competitive salary plus a Private Pension Plan with 100% company matching (up to 5%).
  • Benefits Package: Meal (VR) and Food (VA) vouchers, plus Transportation Voucher (CLT).
  • Prime Infrastructure: Office located in the Avenida Paulista area (easy access to subway/bus/bike lanes) and high-performance equipment (Dell laptops).

If you thrive on challenges, value collaboration in a global culture, and want to build your career in one of São Paulo's most iconic regions, come join our team!

  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo;
  • Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety;

Gestão da Tripulação

  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais.

Conformidade e Registros

  • Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave;
  • Registrar ocorrências que demandem inspeção obrigatória, como pouso duro, turbulência severa, tail strike, RTO, incidência de raio e excedentes de limites operacionais;

  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) e da Política Ambiental.

Cabine e Passageiros

  • Assegurar a transmissão das instruções de Segurança;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança em situações normais, de emergência e em evacuação;
  • Assegurar a integridade e a Segurança da cabine de comando;
  • Garantir a correta utilização dos equipamentos de emergência.

Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:

Formação

  • Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior é um diferencial)
  • Experiência superior na função

Certificações Obrigatórias

  • Licença de Piloto de Linha Aérea (PLA);

  • Certificado Médico Aeronáutico (CMA) válido;

title: Assistente de Supply Chain (BKO Compras)

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

title: Analista Contract Manager II
description:
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contract Manager para realizar a gestão estratégica de um portfólio de contratos pertencentes a um ou mais Projetos de Capital da empresa, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, atuando nos seguintes pilares:

  • Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;
  • Gestão de alterações contratuais (análise de mérito e valor para change order, Claim, back charge);
  • Gestão de conflitos (negociações, análise de cenários para tomada de decisão);
  • Gestão de registros;
  • Gestão das relações com as partes interessadas (internas e externas).

No setor de Engenharia, essa posição irá atuar na equipe do projeto, reportando-se aos Project Managers, atuando de maneira transversal entre as disciplinas nos projetos, com reporte duplo à Gerência Corporativa de Contratos e Riscos. A função atuará de forma integrativa, garantindo comunicação fluida e tomadas de decisão de forma multidisciplinar.

Objetivo estratégico: melhorar a previsibilidade e assertividade dos resultados dos projetos em questão, através da prevenção de desvios contratuais e predição das tendências identificadas na gestão de riscos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Monitoramento e controle dos indicadores contratuais a nível contrato e projeto;
  • Gestão/mediação de negociações e conflitos;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da governança e procedimentos de gestão de contratos e riscos;
  • Realizar reporting executivo em frequência adequada (indicadores, status de conflitos sob gestão da área, negociações pré-contratação, tendências identificadas em fase de implantação, etc).
  • Gestão de registros realizados através de instrumentos contratuais e de comunicação (RDO, atas, cartas, e-mails, relatórios), realizando análise dos registros, definição de respostas e casos prioritários.
  • Gestão de escopo, identificando potenciais desvios (técnicos ou contratuais), monitorando prazos, obrigações e responsabilidades das partes do contrato.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão/administração de contratos e negociação;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiências em gestão de riscos contratuais;
  • Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no Rio de Janeiro

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência envolvendo: gestão de disputas, arbitragens e/ou de projetos, formação de preço/orçamento, planejamento, gestão de custos;
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, RMP, IPMA, CCM, etc.);
  • Experiência com projetos de transmissão;
  • Vivência em ambientes com cultura Lean e foco em melhoria contínua.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios:

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:

• Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Auxílio-educacional;

title: Técnico Mecânica III (Linha de Fibras)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Liderar e executar atividades complexas de manutenção mecânica preventiva e corretiva nos equipamentos e sistemas da linha de fibras, atuando no diagnóstico de falhas críticas e na implementação de soluções técnicas que garantam a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos ativos. Conduzir intervenções em equipamentos do processo, como prensas de lavagem, digestores, impbin, misturadores, agitadores e depuradores, assegurando o correto funcionamento dos sistemas mecânicos. Atuar conforme planos de manutenção, procedimentos técnicos e normas de segurança, contribuindo para a estabilidade operacional, aumento da disponibilidade dos equipamentos e melhoria contínua da eficiência do processo.

Atividades Principais:

  • Planejar, executar e supervisionar atividades de manutenção preventiva de alta complexidade em equipamentos e máquinas das áreas de digestores (vasos de cozimento, sistemas de alimentação e descarga, otimizando planos e procedimentos, identificando e corrigindo falhas potenciais e garantindo a confiabilidade dos ativos;
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas críticas em equipamentos e máquinas, utilizando instrumentos de diagnóstico avançados (análise de vibração, termografia, ultrassom), desenvolvendo planos de reparo eficientes e liderando a equipe na execução de intervenções complexas, incluindo desmontagem, montagem, alinhamento de precisão, balanceamento dinâmico e serviços especializados de solda e usinagem;
  • Liderar a análise de falhas recorrentes e críticas, utilizando metodologias de análise de causa raiz (RCA), desenvolvendo soluções técnicas inovadoras e propondo modificações e melhorias nos equipamentos e sistemas para aumentar a confiabilidade, reduzir custos de manutenção e otimizar a performance;
  • Ler e interpretar desenhos técnicos mecânicos detalhados, diagramas hidráulicos e pneumáticos complexos, manuais de equipamentos especializados e especificações técnicas avançadas, assim como, elaborar planos de manutenção detalhados, procedimentos de trabalho seguros (PTs) e instruções de trabalho (ITs);
  • Utilizar e garantir a correta calibração de ferramentas manuais, elétricas, pneumáticas e instrumentos de medição de alta precisão e diagnóstico avançado, seguindo as normas de segurança e conservação;
  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de melhoria de equipamentos e instalações, definindo escopo, recursos, cronograma e liderando a equipe na montagem, comissionamento e testes de novos equipamentos nas áreas designadas;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos detalhados sobre as atividades de manutenção executadas, as falhas críticas diagnosticadas, as soluções aplicadas, as análises de causa raiz e as recomendações para futuras intervenções e melhorias, apresentando resultados e análises para a gestão;
  • Treinar, mentorar e avaliar o desempenho técnico dos técnicos mecânicos I e II, compartilhando conhecimentos especializados, melhores práticas de manutenção e desenvolvendo as habilidades da equipe;
  • Garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de segurança do trabalho, utilizando e fiscalizando o uso dos Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) adequados para cada atividade, liderando a elaboração de procedimentos de segurança, análise de risco (APR) e identificando e mitigando situações de risco;
  • Liderar e participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas com a equipe de manutenção, engenharia e outras áreas, contribuindo com expertise técnica para a solução de problemas complexos, a definição de estratégias de manutenção e a melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;

Requisitos

  • Curso técnico completo em Mecânica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em mecânica industrial (elementos de máquinas, lubrificação industrial especializada, sistemas hidráulicos e pneumáticos complexos, transmissão de potência, termodinâmica básica);
  • Conhecimento em manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos industriais, com atuação em desmontagem, montagem, inspeção e ajustes de conjuntos mecânicos;
  • Experiência em diagnóstico de falhas mecânicas, identificação de desgastes e análise de condições operacionais de equipamentos do processo.
  • Domínio em troca e montagem de rolamentos, selagens, mancais, acoplamentos, polias, correias e sistemas de transmissão mecânica.
  • Conhecimento em alinhamento de conjuntos rotativos, ajustes mecânicos de precisão e utilização de instrumentos de medição como relógio comparador, paquímetro e micrômetro;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-13, NR-33, NR-35) e legislação pertinente;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão da manutenção (CMMS) e análise de dados de manutenção.

title: Bid Analyst (Temporary)
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end bid management for public and private tenders, including managing timelines, content development, and submission processes.
  • Drive the preparation of commercial proposals, including coordination of technical, financial, and legal inputs.
  • Manage internal approval processes and ensure alignment with global standards and risk frameworks.
  • Ensure all proposals are compliant with regulatory and client requirements (Cyber, Safety, ESG, Standards, etc.), professional, and aligned with Envision’s brand and value proposition.
  • Maintain a library of standard templates, case studies, and pre-qualification documents to support future bids.
  • Provide feedback on market trends, pricing, and competitor benchmarking from tender outcomes.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or related field.
  • At least 5-7 years of experience in bid or proposal management, preferably in the renewable energy, infrastructure, or power sectors. Further ~ 5 years of experience spent in end-to-end project management and delivery a plus.
  • Desired/required knowledge of project management, including planning, schedule tracking, cost control, and team management.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian tendering processes, bidding laws, procedures and commercial frameworks in utility-scale energy projects.
  • Strong cross-functional coordination to gather inputs from internal teams and manage submissions from external contributing parties (BOP contractors, other OEMs).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills: Effective verbal and written communication and the development of compelling bids. Ability to understand underlying needs or concerns, creating a shared understanding of desired outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving skills: Identifying and resolving technical integration issues as well as stakeholder issues, suggesting appropriate risk mitigation strategies and driving acceptance.
  • Self-starter with a collaborative mindset and ability to work across time zones and diverse cultures.
  • Ability to communicate in English. Spanish is a plus

Contract Type

CLT — 2-year fixed term contract with possibility of permanent employment.

We Offer

Competitive salary;

Meal Allowance Card;

Health insurance (extended to direct dependents);

Dental insurance (extended to direct dependents);

Opportunity for growth.

title: AMR Sales Engineer
description:
Job Title: Overseas Sales Engineer (AGV/AMR - Latin America Region)

Responsibilities

Market Development & Strategy Execution: Responsible for formulating and executing medium-to-long-term AGV/AMR sales strategies and business development plans for the Latin American region (with a focus on key countries such as Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile), driving sustainable growth of the company's mobile robotics products and solutions in the local market.

Opportunity Exploration & Value Communication: Deeply develop client resources in Latin America, focusing on identifying AGV/AMR business opportunities in sectors such as warehouse logistics, intelligent manufacturing, and retail/consumer goods. Accurately communicate Hikrobot's core technology value and application advantages in the mobile robotics field through localized communication.

Customer Relationship Building & Maintenance: For key clients in the region, including system integrators, logistics automation enterprises, and large warehousing and manufacturing companies, develop and execute business development plans. Establish and deepen long-term, mutually beneficial strategic partnerships through regular visits, technical exchanges, and product training.

End-to-End Project Management: Act as the primary point of contact for clients, efficiently coordinating internal resources across R&D, delivery, and after-sales departments. Resolve commercial, technical, and delivery issues throughout the sales process, ensuring customer satisfaction and successful project implementation.

Sales Operations & Data Analysis: Proficiently use CRM and other sales tools for business process management and sales data tracking analysis. Regularly review sales activities, continuously optimize sales strategies, and ensure the efficient achievement of performance targets.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree or above. Preference for majors in Automation, Mechatronics, Logistics Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, International Trade, Spanish, Portuguese, or related fields (fresh graduates are welcome).

Work Experience: 1-3 years of experience in overseas sales or market development. Experience in industrial automation, intelligent manufacturing, warehouse logistics equipment, AGV/AMR, or robotics system integration is preferred. Young, high-potential talent is welcomed; experience in the Latin American market is a strong plus.

Business Skills: Familiar with the sales process for automation projects, with proven successful cases or internship experience in collaborating with integrators or end clients (e.g., e-commerce, retail, automotive, 3C manufacturing). Possess strong market development skills, business negotiation abilities, and cross-departmental collaboration capabilities.

Core Competencies: Customer-centric, results-oriented, with strong self-motivation and a sense of responsibility. Capable of adapting to frequent overseas business trips (Latin America region) and working effectively in a multicultural environment.

Language Skills

Required: Fluency in business Spanish or Portuguese (able to use as a working language for business negotiations and technical exchanges).

Preferred: Proficiency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a plus; proficiency in English as a working language is also a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in implementing automation equipment or AGV/AMR projects in the Latin American region (especially in Brazil or Mexico) within industries such as warehousing logistics, e-commerce, or manufacturing.

Foundational knowledge of robotics or automation, with the ability to quickly understand key technical highlights of product solutions.

Established network of automation industry clients or partners in the Latin American region.

Experience studying abroad, on exchange, or working in a Latin American country, with familiarity of local business culture and communication styles.

We Offer

Globally Leading Platform: Leverage Hikrobot's world-leading AMR/AGV product lines and technology platform, providing you with a solid foundation in products and technology.

Mature International System: A well-established international market expansion framework and systematic professional training to support your rapid growth.

Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary and benefits package (base salary + high commission + overseas travel allowances) along with a clear long-term career development path.

Young & Dynamic Team: An open, inclusive, and proactive team environment that encourages young professionals to take on responsibilities and quickly grow into regional business leaders.

title: Assessor de Comunicação
description:

Como será seu dia a dia:

· Mapear tendências de comportamento do público e boas práticas do setor cultural e digital.

· Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade da supervisão.

De segunda a sexta, das 9h às 18h.

O que esperamos de você:

· Ensino superior completo em Jornalismo, Relações Públicas, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Design Gráfico ou áreas correlatas.

Ao fazer isso, podemos oferecer uma ampla gama de soluções para diferentes segmentos de mercado, incluindo Laticínios, Sorvetes, Food Service, entre outros.

Atualmente operamos uma planta no Brasil, onde transformamos frutas Premium em preparados de altíssima qualidade. Estamos alocados em Cabreúva/SP, região bastante próxima aos principais clientes, o que viabiliza a entrega dos produtos de maneira mais fresca possível.

  • Gestão da Rotina : Auxiliar os gestores das áreas industriais na manutenção e organização das reuniões de rotina (reuniões de resultados e masterplan);

title: Bolsista Doutor - Indusbello - Estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais| Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Indusbello é uma empresa brasileira referência nos setores odontológico, hospitalar e veterinário, reconhecida por sua atuação inovadora na fabricação de produtos que aliam alta performance, segurança e responsabilidade socioambiental.

Com sede em Londrina (PR) e presença consolidada em mais de 30 países, a Indusbello investe fortemente em pesquisa, desenvolvimento e tecnologia, consolidando-se como uma das marcas líderes em soluções para a saúde.

Seu compromisso com a qualidade, a ética e a inovação contínua norteiam sua atuação no mercado há mais de três décadas. A empresa possui certificações internacionais como ISO 9001, ISO 13485, marcação CE e aprovação de produtos pelo FDA.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em Administração, Engenharia da Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia da Automação ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais, com foco em aumento da competitividade, redução de custos e inovação tecnológica.

Principais Atividades:

  • Planejar e desenvolver projetos de estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais;
  • Propor a internalização de processos produtivos com foco em competitividade;
  • Identificar gargalos produtivos e desenvolver soluções inovadoras ;
  • Implantar novos processos industriais com foco em eficiência e inovação.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria e inovação em processos industriais ;
  • Análise de viabilidade e implantação de projetos de redução de custos;
  • Experiência com internalização de processos produtivos ;
  • Projetos de digitalização e automação industrial.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Gestão da Inovação, Estratégia e Automação Industrial.
  • Conhecimento no ERP Protheus – Totvs.
  • Conhecimento em processos para produtos da área da saúde.

title: HR Operations Senior Specialist
description:
About Us

Keeta is a technology-driven delivery platform that connects consumers with local food and retail merchants and couriers. Operating as an independent brand under Meituan, one of the world’s largest tech-driven retail companies, we are driven by the mission: "Help People Eat Better, Live Better."

Since its founding in March 2010, Meituan has revolutionized the digital landscape, reshaping supply and demand dynamics across service and product retail through rapid growth and innovation. Keeta builds on this industry influence, bringing exceptional capabilities, swift responsiveness, and quality service to elevate the delivery sector and enhance the lives of users worldwide.

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into new markets including Brazil, Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail.

We combine Meituan’s global expertise with local innovation to deliver exceptional, customer-centric services and seamless experiences. Join Keeta as we take this success story into new markets, driving innovation, growth, and excellence.

What You'll Do

We seek an experienced HR Operations Senior Specialist to drive HR policy development, SOP creation, process optimization, and team enablement. This role ensures standardized, well-implemented HR policies and processes support business goals and compliance.

HR Policy Enablement & Governance:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.
  • Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

  • Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.
  • Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..

Quality Controal & Employee Experience

  • Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.
  • Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.
  • Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.
  • Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in HR operations, policy management, or process governance within an international organization.
  • Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.
  • Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.
  • Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

What Make This Role Exciting

  • Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.
  • Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.
  • Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.
  • Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan’s global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You’ll be part of a company that’s transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you’ll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Brazil, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You’ll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let’s build the future of food delivery.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.

Responsibilities

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to Staff Accountant

Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm EST

Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)

Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: System Architect
description:
Project Description:

Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer).
  • Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals.
  • Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs.
  • Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits.
  • Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment.
  • Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP).
  • Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness.
  • Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms.
  • Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines.
  • Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability.
  • Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams.
  • Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance.
  • Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations.

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems.
  • Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI.
  • Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact).
  • Strong embedded system architecture experience.
  • Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge.
  • Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration.
  • Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs.
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures.
  • Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.

Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
description:
The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions.
  • Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions.
  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities.
  • Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies.
  • Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.).
  • Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions.
  • Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers.
  • Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness.
  • Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions.
  • Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes.
  • Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required.
  • Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced).
  • 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding.
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

title: L3 Application Support Engineer
description:
ITC Infotech is looking for Application Support Engineer - Level 3 to join our team in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Working Mode: Onsite (5 days a week)

Required Language : Fluent English

About Us:

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a hands-on L3 Support Engineer who will act as the escalation point for critical production issues across trading and risk systems. The role focuses on deep incident diagnosis, partnering with engineering for fixes and reliability improvements, and building the tooling, runbooks, and documentation that enable L1/L2 teams to resolve issues faster.

Responsibilities:

  • Own L3 escalations end-to-end: triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident follow-up with engineering and stakeholders.
  • Partner with product and engineering to improve reliability, operability, and supportability of applications, including logging, metrics, and alert quality.
  • Develop scripts, runbooks, diagnostics, and quality-of-life tools that streamline investigations and reduce meantime to resolution.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation for L1/L2 teams; deliver enablement sessions as needed.
  • Contribute to incident reviews and problem management, driving permanent fixes and automation for recurring issues.
  • Participate in a limited weekend/on-call rotation (approximately 4–6 weekends per year) with compensating time-off per policy.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and 3+ years in software engineering or production support.
  • Proficient in Java or a similar language; strong debugging skills and ability to write scripts for diagnostics and updates. Familiarity with Linux and bash.
  • Clear, empathetic communicator capable of translating complex technical issues for diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated bias for action: resolve incidents while building long-term fixes and automations.
  • Strong problem-solving: identify edge cases, add validations, and anticipate failure modes.
  • Experience with SDLC and support tooling: GitLab, incident management, JIRA, and standard ticket triage/prioritization.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting trading systems or desks at a large investment bank.
  • SQL proficiency for rapid data validation and incident triage.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming and microservices-based Java/SOA environments.
  • Monitoring/alerting setup and tuning (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, PagerDuty).
  • Knowledge of Fixed Income products (Rates, Credit, FX, Commodities) and related market workflows.
  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI/CD practices and agile delivery.

Work model and schedule

  • Hybrid collaboration with engineering and trading support teams.
  • Weekend/on-call rotation: approximately 4–6 weekends per year; scheduling communicated in advance

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.

O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.

Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability

O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição

  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.

Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou BA em projetos complexos.

Conhecimento sólido em meios de pagamento ou experiência no mercado financeiro.

Habilidade para traduzir requisitos do cliente em histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.

Venha ser um Firedever!

title: Consultor de vendas - Zona Sul e Zona Oeste
description:

Embora o carro tenha um papel fundamental na vida de muitas pessoas, só 25% da população da América Latina consegue ter acesso a ele. E foi por isso que a Kovi nasceu: para mudar essa estatística!

Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo “pague o que usar”, compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!

O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e de aprendizado constante. #VemSerKover!

title: Analista de Business Development (Hablante de español)
description:

En Amaris Consulting, creemos que la tecnología debe estar al servicio de las personas — y no al revés. Somos una consultora independiente de tecnología y gestión que apoya a empresas en sus proyectos de transformación en todo el mundo.

Nuestro objetivo es construir un futuro más inteligente y sostenible, impulsando la innovación y el crecimiento de nuestros clientes y de nuestro talento.

Relación con el Cliente

  • Monitorear las actividades de los clientes para anticipar y ganar nuevos proyectos.
  • Mantener actualizado el portafolio de clientes y fortalecer las alianzas existentes.
  • Abrir nuevas cuentas, gestionando aspectos legales y contractuales.

Gestión Financiera

  • Analizar y optimizar el Profit & Loss (P&L), calculando márgenes.
  • Realizar análisis avanzados de rentabilidad, identificar oportunidades de mejora y desarrollar planes de acción para optimizar la facturación y el margen contributivo.
  • Gestionar temas relacionados con la recuperación de créditos.

Gestión de Equipo

  • Contribuir en la elaboración y análisis de planes de negocio.
  • Acompañar y apoyar el desarrollo de las personas clave del equipo.
  • Proponer e implementar nuevos procesos e iniciativas de mejora.

Recursos Humanos

  • Participar en el reclutamiento y gestión del equipo de consultores (prospección, entrevistas, reportes, firma de contratos, etc.).
  • Acompañar el desarrollo de carrera del equipo (asignación de roles, evaluaciones, involucramiento de talentos clave, etc.).
  • Anticipar y gestionar situaciones de intercontrato, proponiendo soluciones adecuadas.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia comprobada en ventas B2B, con historial de cumplimiento o superación de objetivos.
  • Experiencia en el mercado tecnológico.
  • Sólido conocimiento de técnicas de ventas y del entorno corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación.
  • Dominio fluido de portugués, inglés y español (obligatorio).
  • Título universitario completo.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar.

Lo que ofrecemos

  • Un entorno internacional con oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
  • La posibilidad de trabajar directamente con clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos y Europa).
  • Presencia en São Paulo, Curitiba y Río de Janeiro, con oportunidades de movilidad entre proyectos.
  • Un modelo de negocio sólido y sostenible, con un crecimiento anual del 52% y más de 400 proyectos activos en Brasil.
  • Una cultura que valora el acompañamiento individual, el desarrollo de competencias y la formación continua.
  • Un enfoque centrado en las personas — sin bodyshopping, con foco en la carrera y el desarrollo profesional.

En Amaris Consulting, promovemos un entorno inclusivo y valoramos la diversidad. Todas las candidaturas son consideradas sin distinción de género, origen, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad o edad.

Join a market‑leading firm at a moment of transformation in how we build capabilities, develop leaders, and enable performance through learning. This role sits at the intersection of Learning & Development, people analytics, and talent systems, partnering with HR and business teams to deliver learning solutions that are practical, scalable, and impact‑oriented.

You’ll play a hands‑on role in delivering learning programs, supporting managers and employees with development tools, and ensuring learning initiatives translate into real capability growth. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys strong execution, learning operations, and continuous improvement.

Purpose of the role

Design, deliver and evolve learning solutions that build critical capabilities, strengthen leadership effectiveness, and directly support business priorities. This role operates at the intersection of learning strategy, execution excellence, and data‑informed decision making—moving beyond training delivery into capability impact.

  • Support the end‑to‑end execution of learning initiatives, from needs analysis through delivery and evaluation

  • Support continuous improvement of programs based on feedback and data insights

Experience & Scope

  • 3+ years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development roles
  • Proven experience working in complex, fast‑paced organizations, with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Hands‑on leadership of:
  • End‑to‑end learning initiatives (needs analysis, design, delivery, measurement)
  • Manager and leader enablement programs
  • Facilitation of learning experiences (virtual and/or in‑person)
  • Strong grounding in:
  • Competency and capability frameworks
  • Blended learning ecosystems (formal, informal, experiential)
  • Experience designing and rolling out:
  • Leadership development programs
  • Core skills or functional capability curricula
  • Scalable learning solutions
  • Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills:

  • Comfortable coordinating learning operations, data, and reporting within HCM ecosystems
  • English proficiency required (written and spoken)

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Company Description

Holy Koolaid is a YouTube channel dedicated to science, skepticism, and critical thinking . The channel explores topics such as archaeology, religion, pseudoscience, cults, history, and misinformation. Our goal is to create engaging educational content that encourages curiosity and critical thinking .

Role Description

Holy Koolaid Media is looking for a highly skilled video editor with strong motion graphics experience to help produce fast-paced documentary and explainer videos for YouTube. Our content explores history, archaeology, science, and critical thinking , often examining religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation through a skeptical lens. We are looking for someone who can turn research-heavy scripts into compelling visual stories using animation, motion graphics, archival footage, and creative editing. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and comfortable working with complex historical and scientific material . The position is fully remote , with occasional meetings in São Paulo preferred but not required .

What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form YouTube documentary and explainer videos
  • Create motion graphics and animations that help explain complex ideas
  • Cut footage to match script timing and narration
  • Add B-roll, archival footage, and visual references
  • Design and animate titles, diagrams, maps, and visual explanations
  • Add sound effects and polish audio
  • Work closely with the creator to ensure the visuals enhance the storytelling
  • Help research and locate visual assets relevant to historical and scientific topics
  • Maintain strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and clarity

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro (this is essential)
  • Experience with Photoshop
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to edit according to script timing and narrative pacing
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts
  • Extremely detail-oriented
  • Ability to research and find visual material when needed
  • At least 2 years of experience with motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with After Effects
  • Some familiarity with Adobe Audition
  • Experience editing YouTube videos
  • Experience with documentary-style editing
  • Interest in history, archaeology, or science
  • Comfortable working on content that critically examines religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation
  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher (flexible if editing skills are exceptional)

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Thinks like a storyteller, not just an editor
  • Can take complex ideas and make them visually understandable
  • Is comfortable learning new topics quickly
  • Is curious and enjoys researching historical and scientific subjects
  • Can work with fast-paced YouTube content
  • Has the resilience and independence to figure things out and solve problems

How to Apply

Please include:

  • Portfolio or demo reel
  • Examples of motion graphics or animation work
  • Examples of video editing projects
  • A short note explaining why you are interested in this role

Applicants without a portfolio or demo reel will not be considered.
